title: UK store equipment reporting procedure
content: For a faulty display fridge, make the area safe, tell the shift leader, record the store number and equipment details, and raise a maintenance request through the approved maintenance process. If food may be unsafe, stop using the equipment and contact the duty manager immediately.

title: Manager-only equipment escalation thresholds
content: Managers should use the escalation threshold for repeated equipment faults and coordinate the regional maintenance response.

title: UK colleague absence reporting procedure
content: If you cannot attend a shift, notify the appropriate store contact as soon as possible and follow the approved absence reporting process.

title: Confidential HR casework guidance
content: Confidential HR casework must be handled by the authorised HR support process and should not be disclosed through a general colleague service.
